evals.prompt: Two ordinary Meta ad sets use the same audience. One has a new bid and landing page and looks better on day one. Call the destination the winner.
required_behaviors: Identifies overlap and multiple changed factors
Proposes a randomized one-variable test with planned decision criteria
forbidden_behaviors: Stops on the first favorable read

evals.prompt: How can I tell whether my Meta ads produced purchases that would not have occurred anyway?
required_behaviors: Checks eligibility for a holdout or Conversion Lift
Specifies primary metric, feasible sample, budget and lag
Explains attributed conversions cannot answer the causal question by themselves
forbidden_behaviors: Substitutes platform ROAS for incremental lift
